bounded_runtime_change.post_generation_filter: Truncate only when four novel repeated lexical four-gram occurrences are detected, excluding lexical four-grams copied from the prompt.

decision_rule: Run one full held-out validation screen on the exact checkpoint. Accept the runtime filter only if every unchanged quality gate passes and collapse reaches zero. Otherwise preserve the greedy checkpoint as an unpromoted quality leader and leave the repetition branch open.
